# Data-quality record (generated by scripts/01_eda.py)
* Partitions: train 80 trips, student_test 10 trips; evaluator_test not provided to students.
* Invalid / NaN coordinates removed: 0; duplicate timestamps removed: 0; out-of-order timestamps: 0.
* Sampling: median interval 1 s; 96.7% of all steps are exactly 1 s; 70 gaps longer than 60 s; longest gap 153064 s.
* Trips are spread over 54 distinct longitudes (worldwide) -> a per-trip local metric projection is used.
* Every .arcs file only references valid node rows; 0 isolated nodes in total; networks are mostly one large component (median largest strongly-connected share 0.96).
* Reference routes are almost always connected (mean share of consecutive arcs that share a node: 0.9994).
* Label alignment: 9.9% of training observations are > 100 m from their aligned reference arc; trips with > 50 % such points: 00000033, 00000054 (GPS appears systematically offset from the route). These observations are excluded from training labels.
* Candidate radius 50 m chosen from the radius sweep (miss rate flattens after ~40-50 m while candidates per point keep growing).
